exposure: early physiological parameters (lactate, base excess, 'toe-core' gap)
cohort: Seventy-seven infants with gastroschisis treated with a preformed silo, cared for in a tertiary surgical neonatal intensive care unit during a 10-year period.
finding: Survival was 100% in infants with gastroschisis managed with a preformed silo, and sepsis and gastroschisis complexity were significantly associated with increased length of stay and duration of parenteral nutrition.
